title: Matt Report: write-up of Rob Walling's Drip acquisition by LeadPages (host's summary, no Rob quotes)
summary: This is Matt's blog intro to a podcast episode with Rob Walling, not Rob's own words. It notes Drip hit a scale his other products hadn't, growth was hard, and growing fast required more engineers, servers and marketing, which made the LeadPages acquisition attractive. The interview audio itself is not transcribed.
